g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Start checking the weather as soon as a trip is decided, using historical data or future/m
onthly forecasts to get a good estimate of the expected weather. → Defer the final go/no-g
o decision on a trip until about two or three days before, when the forecast is more accur
ate, and then decide based on the final forecast.
